ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity pixels (white/light gray) and 40% low-intensity pixels (black/dark gray) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white blobs occupy the central and distal fields of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated in the peduncle region, the median notch, and a narrow band along the trailing edge. Localized yellowish-brown pixel clusters (diatom film) are present on the medial-lower portions of the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical pixel offset relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; high-frequency peaks and valleys are visible, with more pronounced jagged edges near the outer distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch transitioning into a convex sweep toward the dorsal-lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel clusters visible on the white field of the right lobe (distal-mid) and left lobe (medial).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multi-pixel horizontal dark lines crossing the white pigmentation on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular pixel loss/indentation on the trailing edge of the far left tip; extensive yellowish biological film coverage across the center of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharply defined black distal tip on the right lobe contrasting against the inner white field.
